query:
SELECT 
  pc.parentProductId,
  p1.name as parentName,
  p1.avgCost as parentCost,
  pc.childProductId,
  p2.name as childName,
  p2.avgCost as childCost,
  pc.quantity,
  (pc.quantity * p2.avgCost) as componentSubtotal
FROM productCompositions pc
JOIN products p1 ON pc.parentProductId = p1.id
JOIN products p2 ON pc.childProductId = p2.id
ORDER BY pc.parentProductId
